newsitem.title: CHINA: Hongkong Bank tipped to bring HK$ FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank tipped to bring HK$ FRCD.

text.p: Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corp, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, is expected to issue a three-year floating-rate certificate of deposit (FRCD), bankers said on Wednesday.

They said it planned to pay a coupon of about 20 basis points over the one month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate, and, with fees, an all-in return to top-tier lenders of 27 basis points, identical to the all-in of its three-year FRCD launched earlier this year.
Bankers expected an issue size of up to HK$3.5 billion.
It would be the third FRCD for the bank this year.
It raised HK$2.5 billion through a three year FRCD in May, which paid an all-in of 27 basis points, and HK$3.5 billion through a five year issue in January.
